Maya (CS): FYI — Vevra pushed back on our DPA draft. They want clarifications on data residency for Dedicated and exact token retention for embeddings. Renewal in ~45d, flagging as potential risk.
Liam (Solutions Eng): Do we have a simple mapping of where tokens/embeddings live for Dedicated vs Private? customer asked for KMS key ownership details too.
Sophia (Security): For Dedicated: customer data stays in their isolated GPU pool, but backups/metrics may hit control plane unless we use Private. KMS: we can support BYOK for Private; for Dedicated we use tenant-scoped keys (managed) unless they opt into an enterprise KMS integration.
Ken (Acct Exec): Vevra's security lead insisted on explicit retention periods (logs, prompts, embeddings). They need a statement they can attach to their vendor risk form.
Maya (CS): Can we draft a one-paragraph answer + an evidence doc link? they want something succinct to paste into their questionnaire. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Liam (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a short mapping. Quick draft: `Dedicated: inference requests and KV cache stored on tenant GPUs; ephemeral by default. Embeddings persisted in customer workspace storage for X days (configurable). Control plane logs retained 30 days by default.` Thoughts?
Sophia (Security): Don't put `X` — use explicit numbers. Suggest: embeddings retention default 90 days, configurable to 0/30/90/365 for enterprise tenants. Control plane logs 30 days. KMS key provenance: managed keys (Redwood) for Hosted/Dedicated; BYOK available for Private.
Maya (CS): Perfect. Can you add a sentence about export/deletion: customers can request a full data export and deletions via support with SLA 7 days (for Dedicated) / 14 days (Hosted)? Vevra cares about timely deletion.
Sophia (Security): 7 days for Dedicated on-prem or VPC is ok. Hosted deletions have additional propagation windows -> 14 days. Add note about audit logs and proof-of-deletion samples for SOC2 auditors.
Liam (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble a one-paragraph answer + small evidence pack. Example snippet to include in their form:
```
Data residency: Dedicated deployments keep inference data in customer-dedicated resources in the selected region. Embeddings retention: default 90 days (configurable). Deletion/export: submit request via support; Dedicated SLA 7d, Hosted SLA 14d. KMS: BYOK supported on Private; tenant-scoped managed keys used for Dedicated unless BYOK requested.
```
Maya (CS): Awesome. Ken — can you offer to set up a 30-min enablement call this week with Vevra's security lead? That helps reduce renewal friction.
Ken (Acct Exec): Yup, proposing Wed 10am PT. I'll CC legal if they want contract language tweaks.
evidence-bot: Evidence package created: `vevra-evidence-1762143658.zip` (contains SOC2 excerpts, KMS integration notes, sample deletion logs). Link: https://files.redwood.example/vevra-evidence-1762143658.zip
Maya (CS): Shared draft answer + link to evidence pack to Vevra. Scheduling call for Wed 10am PT. I'll update this thread after the call. :phone: :thumbsup: 
Liam (Solutions Eng): If they ask about embeddings encryption at rest, note we encrypt workspace storage with AES-256 and envelope encryption with KMS.
Sophia (Security): Adding that and a short SOC2 control reference in the evidence pack (CC3.4 / Logging retention).
Maya (CS): Great. Action items: (1) Liam finalize paragraph & evidence snippets, (2) Sophia add SOC2 references & deletion proof sample, (3) Ken schedule enablement + loop legal, (4) Maya send to customer and run call. Tracking here — will report back post-call.
